newsitem.title: USA: Barbers Hairstyling Q1 net rises. [CORRECTED 01:27 GMT 29/1]
newsitem.headline: Barbers Hairstyling Q1 net rises. [CORRECTED 01:27 GMT 29/1]

text.p: Barbers Hairstyling for Men and Women Inc said Tuesday higher revenues from its company- owned salons helped net income rise 7.4 percent in the first quarter ended December 26.
The company reported net income of $219,000 in the period, compared with $204,000 one year ago. Revenues rose to $4.8 million from $4.5 million in fiscal 1996, Barbers said.
Barbers officials said the company is on plan to open 80 salons (corrects from "80 company-owned salons") and to look for gains in profits and earnings per share of 20 percent in fiscal 1997.
The company operates 940 franchised and company-owned salons. Its shares were trading down 13/32 Tuesday at 6-3/4.
